<div class="grid gap-4">
<div class="g-col-12 g-col-lg-7">
<h4><i class="bi bi-envelope-fill text-accent me-1"></i> General Inquiries</h4>
<p class="text-muted">
For questions about the portal, data requests, or this proof of concept,
reach out using the placeholder contact details below.
</p>
<ul class="list-unstyled text-muted">
<li class="mb-2"><i class="bi bi-envelope me-2"></i> <code>info@example.org</code> <span class="text-muted small">(placeholder)</span></li>
<li class="mb-2"><i class="bi bi-telephone me-2"></i> +255 000 000 000 <span class="text-muted small">(placeholder)</span></li>
<li class="mb-2"><i class="bi bi-geo-alt me-2"></i> Dar es Salaam, Tanzania <span class="text-muted small">(placeholder address)</span></li>
</ul>
<h4 class="mt-4"><i class="bi bi-mortarboard-fill text-accent me-1"></i> University Partnerships</h4>
<p class="text-muted">
Represent a university research office, library, or department interested
in partnering? See <a href="partners.html">For Universities &amp; Partners</a>
or contact us directly.
</p>
<h4 class="mt-4"><i class="bi bi-database-fill-add text-accent me-1"></i> Contribute a Dataset</h4>
<p class="text-muted">
Have a socio-economic dataset that could benefit student researchers?
We'd like to hear from you — include the dataset's source, coverage,
and licensing terms when you reach out.
</p>
</div>

<div class="g-col-12 g-col-lg-5">
<div class="card border-0 shadow-soft rounded-4">
<div class="card-body p-4">
<h5 class="mb-3"><i class="bi bi-chat-dots-fill text-accent me-1"></i> Send a Message</h5>
<p class="text-muted small">
<i class="bi bi-info-circle me-1"></i>
Demo form only — wire this to the same form-service placeholder used
on <a href="request-access.html">Request Access</a>, or your preferred
contact-form provider. <!-- TODO: backend -->
</p>
<!-- TODO (form endpoint): replace YOUR_FORM_ID with a real Formspree endpoint -->
<form action="https://formspree.io/f/YOUR_FORM_ID" method="POST">
<div class="mb-3">
<label for="contact_name" class="form-label">Name</label>
<input type="text" class="form-control" id="contact_name" name="name" required>
</div>
<div class="mb-3">
<label for="contact_email" class="form-label">Email</label>
<input type="email" class="form-control" id="contact_email" name="email" required>
</div>
<div class="mb-3">
<label for="contact_message" class="form-label">Message</label>
<textarea class="form-control" id="contact_message" name="message" rows="4" required></textarea>
</div>
<button type="submit" class="btn btn-accent">
<i class="bi bi-send-fill me-1"></i> Send
</button>
</form>
</div>
</div>
</div>
